# Foundations {.part}

# Method

We took water samples at four sites along the river, once a week for six weeks.

## Sites

The sites are the weir, the mill, the ford, and the mouth.

## Laboratory

Each sample went to the laboratory on the same day.

# Results

Nitrate levels went up from the weir to the mouth.

## Nitrate

The change was largest after the mill.

## Variation

The ford had the most variation between weeks.
